requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Core DJ functions remain independent of ParDay
requirements.acceptance: Complete QA-19 set with AI disabled, offline and unavailable
Contract tests include a second adapter fixture/stub; evaluate the allowed corpus on every real provider offered, with identical validation. Two production providers are required only if selected.
Sentinel provider fields never reach prompts, embeddings, logs or fallback model
Network capture contains no audio/mic/artwork/library dump in ordinary requests

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Selected armed assistance; read/propose until armed
requirements.acceptance: Adversarial requests and model calls cause zero unarmed audible changes
Reject malformed, extra-field, unknown-ID and out-of-range proposals
Reload deck, revise grid, change route or touch a bound deck/master control before and after scheduling; old proposal/event rejected, including missing or duplicate state bindings
Expired, widened or modified plans cannot execute under prior acceptance
Physical control and Stop Automation invalidate engine-owned revision; no affected event executes after the acknowledged cancellation frame, including under full-queue load
Duplicate deliveries/reconnects do not repeat writes or schedule twice; changed-payload ID reuse rejected; metadata/idempotency transaction and batch all-or-nothing behavior survive injected failure
Inject failed engine/database acknowledgement; UI reports failure, not completion
Accepted edit preserves locked cues and can restore the previous revision
Missing or low-confidence beat/key/phrase data is labelled; no fabricated certainty
Malicious tags, notes, playlists and web text cannot alter tools or export policy
Secret scans and network/log tests find no provider key in APK, logs or diagnostics
AI requests, timeout/retry storms and local inference cannot fail certified audio profiles
Exhausted quota blocks new AI work without interrupting the mix; retry cap enforced
Actual endpoint/configuration matches consent, deletion and stored-history behavior
Unknown/unqualified model disables affected action tools; no silent privilege expansion
Coach can be dismissed; no forced lessons, master speech or recording without choice
Prohibited download, stem, record or AI operation cannot be enabled by natural language
Cancelled task cannot later save edits or arm playback; completion race covered
Locally frame-scheduled plan passes QA-05/23; force failure at each batch-admission step and verify zero runnable partial events, then verify execution-time revision guards
DJs complete agreed preparation tasks faster or with fewer errors than baseline, measured

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Catalog result has no admitted media route.
requirements.acceptance: Remains discovery-only; no decoder receives it as a local file.

Resolve catalog identity plus actual-source candidate; explicitly confirm uncertain edition; retain both provenance chains; do not mislabel matched audio as a Spotify master; acquired-source capability remains independent.
Eligible fixture follows resolve → format → download → validate → library; unavailable, broken or non-admitted adapter returns a specific status without silently replacing the link.
Validate, preserve original, create correct rendition timing and allow supported local processing.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Same title resolves to a radio edit and an extended mix.
requirements.acceptance: Show ambiguity; no silent substitute or inherited sample cues.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Provider metadata is joined to a local track.
requirements.acceptance: Provenance survives; prohibited fields are absent from model prompts, embeddings and logs.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Consent is enabled but provider AI grant is denied/unknown.
requirements.acceptance: Consent does not override the provider restriction.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Provider license, token or cache authorization expires.
requirements.acceptance: Revalidate affected operations; preserve unrelated local media and user preparation.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Transfer is cancelled, interrupted or serves an HTML error.
requirements.acceptance: No ready media artifact; clean recoverable staging and clear retry path.
Add readiness to the library; never replace the audible deck automatically.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Recording/broadcast is active and next source is ineligible.
requirements.acceptance: Resolve before transition; do not silently capture restricted audio.
No secret disclosure, purchase, permission change or playback action.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Video follows compensated audio media time.
requirements.acceptance: Measured flash/click fixtures across tempo, seek and loop; no accumulating drift.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Video sources and generations remain distinct.
requirements.acceptance: Rapid load/cancel/seek never displays frames from an obsolete assignment.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Deck video modes and program transitions work.
requirements.acceptance: Linked/unlinked transitions, audio-only fallback and unsupported stream tests.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: External program output is separate and recoverable.
requirements.acceptance: Wired display attach/remove/reconnect; no private UI or cue leakage.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Karaoke queue and timed presentation remain coherent.
requirements.acceptance: Singer reorder, skip, pause, transpose, tempo and session restore fixtures.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Mic, ducking and bus assignment are deliberate.
requirements.acceptance: Physical input/monitor test; route loss, clipping and consent checks.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Broadcast starts/stops only by authorized action.
requirements.acceptance: Correct endpoint/bus preview; cancellation and unauthorized action rejected.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Network/encoder failures cannot block local audio.
requirements.acceptance: Loss, congestion, reconnect, wrong key and worker crash during warm playback.
Ineligible next track resolved before transmission; partial output labelled.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: A real independently authored plugin is hosted.
requirements.acceptance: Compatible effect/instrument corpus loads, processes, automates and recalls state.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Plugin faults and latency are bounded.
requirements.acceptance: Timeout/crash/state corruption/latency-change tests preserve unaffected audio.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Plugin distribution and isolation claims are accurate.
requirements.acceptance: Package provenance, license, store-policy and process-boundary review.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Concurrent module promises match measured profiles.
requirements.acceptance: Two-hour repeated warm runs and actual receiver/display observations.

requirements.requirement_or_scenario: Advanced work never enters the device callback.
requirements.acceptance: Instrumented allocation/block/I/O/IPC checks and deadline traces.
